Shwetha Menon Resigns from AMMA; Mammootty Calls Issues 'Small Matters'

Actress Shwetha Menon has resigned from the Association of Malayalam Movie Artists (AMMA), stating her decision was driven by self-respect. This development comes amidst an ongoing controversy surrounding the organization. Actor Mammootty has commented on the situation, describing the issues within AMMA as "small matters." The controversy and subsequent resignation highlight internal dynamics within the prominent film body.
